description: 台灣中油公司提供電動機車服務加油站 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 僅包含提供電動機車充電服務及電動機車換電服務之加油站，其中電動機車換電服務包含Gogoro電動機車換電、光陽電動機車換電2. 0、光陽電動機車換電3. 0. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
